powers.action_summary: Increase by rule the inspection fee for inspections performed between October 1 and May 31.
powers.quote: provided that the department may by rule increase the fee for inspections performed during the period of October first through May thirty-first
powers.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to inspection fees for certain recurring violations of the housing maintenance code.

powers.agency_full: Department of Housing Preservation and Development
powers.action_summary: Specify by rule additional hazardous or immediately hazardous violations that are exempt from the inspection fee.
powers.quote: or such other hazardous or immediately hazardous violations that the department specifies by rule
powers.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to inspection fees for certain recurring violations of the housing maintenance code.

powers.agency_full: Department of Housing Preservation and Development
powers.action_summary: Set by rule the criteria used to determine which buildings qualify to participate in the alternative enforcement program under this paragraph.
powers.quote: may by rule set criteria for such buildings to participate in the program, which may include, but need not be limited to: the ratio of open hazardous and immediately hazardous violations per dwelling unit, the amount or ratio per dwelling unit of paid or unpaid emergency repair charges and the number of dwelling units that must exist for a building to qualify for participation in the program
powers.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the alternative enforcement program.

powers.agency_full: Department of Housing Preservation and Development
powers.action_summary: Add by rule to the criteria that exclude buildings from the alternative enforcement program.
powers.quote: The department may by rule add to the criteria set forth in subdivision e of this section relating to which buildings are to be excluded from the program.
powers.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the alternative enforcement program.

powers.agency_full: Department of Housing Preservation and Development
powers.action_summary: Specify a later date, beyond the standard fifteen days, by which a building owner must post the required program sign.
powers.quote: or such later date as the department may specify in such notice
powers.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the alternative enforcement program.

powers.agency_full: Department of Housing Preservation and Development
powers.action_summary: Require by rule that the program sign be posted in additional languages beyond English and Spanish.
powers.quote: in any other language the department may require by rule
powers.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the alternative enforcement program.

powers.action_summary: Only honor a civil immigration detainer by holding a person beyond release time or notifying federal immigration authorities of release if federal authorities present a judicial warrant and a database search shows the person was convicted of a violent or serious crime or matches the terrorist screening database.
powers.quote: may only honor a civil immigration detainer by holding a person beyond the time when such person would otherwise be released from the department's custody, in addition to such reasonable time as is necessary to conduct the search specified in subparagraph (ii) of this paragraph, or by notifying federal immigration authorities of such person's release, if:
powers.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to persons not to be detained by the police department.

powers.action_summary: Hold a person for up to 48 hours (excluding weekends and holidays) beyond release time if a database search shows the person was convicted of a violent or serious crime and had illegally re-entered the country, or matches the terrorist screening database.
powers.quote: the department may honor a civil immigration detainer by holding an person for up to forty-eight hours, excluding Saturdays, Sundays and holidays, beyond the time when such person would otherwise be released from the department's custody
powers.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to persons not to be detained by the police department.

powers.actor_raw: the department of correction, in consultation with the department
powers.action_summary: Determine by rule whether newly enacted crimes qualify as felonies involving violence, force, firearms, terrorism, or endangerment/abuse of vulnerable persons for purposes of the 'violent or serious crime' definition.
powers.quote: the department of correction, in consultation with the department, by rule determines to be a felony involving violence, force, firearms, terrorism, or endangerment or abuse of vulnerable persons
affected_groups: persons subject to civil immigration detainers
powers.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to persons not to be detained by the police department.

powers.action_summary: Determine by rule, in consultation with the police department, whether newly enacted crimes qualify as a felony involving violence, force, firearms, terrorism, or endangerment or abuse of vulnerable persons for purposes of the 'violent or serious crime' definition.
powers.quote: the department, in consultation with the police department, by rule determines to be a felony involving violence, force, firearms, terrorism, or endangerment or abuse of vulnerable persons, or any crime for which a change made by the legislature requires amendment of the crimes specified in this paragraph.
powers.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to persons not to be detained by the department of correction.

powers.action_summary: Authorize, by executive order, federal immigration authorities to maintain an office or quarters on department-controlled land for purposes unrelated to civil immigration law enforcement.
powers.quote: the mayor may, by executive order, authorize federal immigration authorities to maintain an office or quarters on such land for purposes unrelated to the enforcement of civil immigration laws.
powers.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to persons not to be detained by the department of correction.

powers.agency_full: Department of Consumer and Worker Protection
powers.action_summary: Promulgate rules as necessary to effectuate the provisions of chapter 9 of title 20, including establishing civil penalties not exceeding two hundred fifty dollars for rule violations.
powers.quote: The commissioner may promulgate such rules as he or she deems necessary to effectuate the provisions of this chapter, including, but not limited to, establishing civil penalties for the violation of such rules in amounts not exceeding two hundred fifty dollars for any such violation.
powers.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to requiring certain qualified transportation benefits.

powers.action_summary: Adjudicate and recover civil penalties from drivers who leave the scene of an incident involving property damage or physical injury without reporting as required by the vehicle and traffic law.
powers.quote: shall be liable for a civil penalty, recoverable at the environmental control board, of not more than five hundred dollars
affected_groups: drivers who leave the scene of an incident without reporting
powers.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to civil penalties for leaving the scene of an incident without reporting.

powers.actor_raw: the commissioner of housing preservation and development
powers.agency_full: Department of Housing Preservation and Development
powers.action_summary: Take all necessary action, including promulgating rules, prior to the local law's effective date to implement its requirements.
powers.quote: the commissioner of housing preservation and development may take all necessary action, including the promulgation of rules, prior to such effective date
powers.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to remedies for breach of the duty of an owner to refrain from harassment of tenants.

powers.actor_raw: the commissioner of housing preservation and development
powers.agency_full: Department of Housing Preservation and Development
powers.action_summary: Take actions necessary for implementation of the law, including promulgating rules, before the law's effective date.
powers.quote: the commissioner of housing preservation and development may take such actions as are necessary for its implementation, including the promulgation of rules, prior to such effective date
powers.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to a rights and responsibilities guide for tenants and owners.

powers.action_summary: Establish a discretionary grant program providing monetary payments to qualified employers for each 2014 qualified employee hired.

powers.law_title: A Local Law to establish a program in relation to the employment of school bus drivers, attendants, dispatchers and mechanics by qualified employers.

powers.action_summary: Establish a discretionary grant program providing monetary payments to qualified employers for each master seniority lists qualified employee hired.
powers.quote: The department may establish a program that shall provide monetary grants to any qualified employer for each master seniority list's qualified employee hired by such qualified employer in an amount equal to the sum of:
powers.law_title: A Local Law to establish a program in relation to the employment of school bus drivers, attendants, dispatchers and mechanics by qualified employers.

powers.action_summary: Promulgate rules as necessary to implement and carry out the disclosure requirements of this local law prior to its effective date.
powers.quote: the campaign finance board may promulgate rules as may be necessary for the purpose of implementing and carrying out the provisions of this local law, prior to its effective date
powers.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to requiring public-facing disclosure of campaign spending.

powers.action_summary: Install door alarms at the discretion of the department, in consultation with the police department, at exterior doors of school buildings including those serving pre-kindergarten through fifth grade or a district 75 program.
powers.quote: Door alarms may be placed at the discretion of the department of education, in consultation with the police department, at the exterior doors of school buildings under the jurisdiction of the department of education, including buildings serving grades pre-kindergarten through five or a district 75 program.
powers.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter, in relation to door alarms in school buildings.

powers.agency_full: Not specified in the law text
powers.action_summary: Establish, by rule, procedures to protect the addresses of domestic violence victims or alternate requirements for applicants lacking a permanent address.

powers.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the creation of a New York city identity card program.

powers.action_summary: Establish a reasonable fee for identity card applications.
powers.quote: The administering agency may establish a reasonable fee for applications for a New York city identity card
powers.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the creation of a New York city identity card program.

powers.agency_full: Not specified in the law text
powers.action_summary: Determine by rule the weight given to each identity document type and require multiple documents to establish identity.

powers.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the creation of a New York city identity card program.

powers.agency_full: Not specified in the law text
powers.action_summary: Determine by rule the weight given to each residency document type and require multiple documents to establish residency.

powers.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the creation of a New York city identity card program.

powers.agency_full: Not specified in the law text
powers.action_summary: Require possession of the identity card to obtain benefits or privileges offered exclusively to cardholders as an incentive to apply.
powers.quote: agencies may require the possession of a New York city identity card to obtain benefits or privileges offered exclusively to those who possess a New York city identity card as an incentive to apply for a New York city identity card
powers.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the creation of a New York city identity card program.

powers.agency_full: Not specified in the law text
powers.action_summary: Take necessary implementation measures, including promulgating rules, prior to the local law's effective date.
powers.quote: the administering agency, as defined in section 3-115 of the administrative code of the city of New York as added by section 1 of this local law, may take such measures as are necessary for the implementation of this local law, including the promulgating of rules, prior to such date
powers.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the creation of a New York city identity card program.

powers.agency_full: New York City Taxi and Limousine Commission
powers.action_summary: Combine points assessed under the critical driver program with points assessed under the persistent violators program when applying subdivisions i and j.
powers.quote: Points assessed pursuant to section 19-507.2 of this chapter may, pursuant to subdivisions i and j of this section, be added to points assessed by the commission under this section for violations of commission rules.
powers.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the New York city taxi and limousine commission's critical drivers and persistent violators programs.

powers.agency_full: New York City Taxi and Limousine Commission
powers.action_summary: Summarily suspend a driver's TLC-issued license while a fitness review or enforcement action is pending.
powers.quote: The commission may summarily suspend the commission issued license of such driver while any fitness review or enforcement action is pending, consistent with the rules of the commission regarding summary suspensions.
powers.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to taxi and limousine commission review of crashes.

powers.agency_full: New York City Taxi and Limousine Commission
powers.action_summary: Summarily suspend the license of a TLC-licensed driver who has been summonsed or charged with a traffic violation or crime in a crash causing critical injury or death.
powers.quote: the license issued to such driver by the commission may be summarily suspended consistent with the rules of the commission regarding summary suspensions
affected_groups: drivers licensed by the taxi and limousine commission
powers.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to traffic violations and serious crashes.

powers.agency_full: New York City Taxi and Limousine Commission
powers.action_summary: Lift a summary suspension of a driver's license under the rules of the commission, upon dismissal of charges, or upon a not-guilty finding, while retaining authority to continue suspension under section 19-540.
powers.quote: A summary suspension pursuant to this section may be lifted pursuant to the rules of the commission or upon dismissal of all such charges or upon a finding of not guilty of all of the stated traffic related violations and crimes, except that the commission may continue to suspend such license pursuant to section 19-540 of this chapter.
affected_groups: drivers licensed by the taxi and limousine commission
powers.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to traffic violations and serious crashes.

powers.action_summary: Promulgate rules necessary to implement the partial abatement program for storm-damaged property.

powers.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to a partial abatement of real property taxes on real property that was rebuilt after being seriously damaged by the severe storm that occurred on the twenty-ninth and thirtieth of October, two thousand twelve in a city having a population of one million or more.

powers.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to requiring insulation of existing concealed pipes exposed during alteration or repair.

powers.quote: the commissioner of finance shall pursuant to such subdivision be authorized to complete the assessment rolls using estimated rates and to collect the sums therein mentioned according to law.

powers.agency_full: Department of Consumer and Worker Protection
powers.action_summary: Exercise all powers relating to receipt, investigation, and resolution of complaints regarding earned sick time, and conduct investigations regarding violations upon the commissioner's own initiative.
powers.citation: NYC Charter § 2203(e), as amended by Section 1
powers.quote: The commissioner shall have all powers as set forth in chapter 8 of title 20 of the administrative code relating to the receipt, investigation, and resolution of complaints thereunder regarding earned sick time, and the power to conduct investigations regarding violations of such chapter upon his or her own initiative.
powers.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter and the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the provision of sick time earned by employees, and section 7 of local law number 46 for the year 2013, relating to such sick time, in relation to the effective date of such local law, and to repeal section 6 of local law number 46 for the year 2013, relating to a determination of the Independent Budget Office.
powers.committee: Committee on Civil Service and Labor

powers.agency_full: Department of Health and Mental Hygiene
powers.action_summary: Promulgate rules necessary for the implementation of the animal abuse registry chapter.
powers.quote: The commissioner may promulgate rules necessary for the implementation of this chapter.
powers.deadline_text: prior to such effective date
affected_groups: persons convicted of animal abuse crimes
powers.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to creating an animal abuse registry.

powers.action_summary: Set by rule an alternative expiration date for registrations to distribute expirations evenly across the year.
powers.quote: or such other date as determined by the commissioner by rule so as to distribute the expiration dates of the registrations evenly over the course of a year
powers.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the creation of a voluntary master environmental hazard remediation technician registration program.

powers.action_summary: Prescribe by rule the form and information required for registration applications.
powers.quote: Each application for the master environmental hazard remediation technician registration program shall be made in such form and shall be accompanied by such information as the commissioner may prescribe by rule.
powers.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the creation of a voluntary master environmental hazard remediation technician registration program.

powers.action_summary: Require by rule additional information to accompany renewal applications for registration.
powers.quote: Applications for renewal of a master environmental hazard remediation technician registration shall be accompanied by the renewal fee and such additional information as the commissioner may require by rule.
powers.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the creation of a voluntary master environmental hazard remediation technician registration program.

powers.action_summary: Charge a fee for registration and renewal of registration as set by department rule.
powers.quote: The commissioner may charge a fee for registration and renewal of registration as set forth in department rules.
powers.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the creation of a voluntary master environmental hazard remediation technician registration program.

powers.action_summary: Suspend or revoke a master environmental hazard remediation technician registration after notice and hearing upon findings of fraud, negligence, incompetence, or noncompliance.
powers.quote: The commissioner, after providing notice and an opportunity to be heard, may suspend or revoke any master environmental hazard remediation technician registration issued under this chapter upon a finding by the department or other governmental agencies of fraudulent dealings, negligence or incompetence, or failure to comply with this code or any order, rule, or requirement lawfully made by the commissioner.
powers.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the creation of a voluntary master environmental hazard remediation technician registration program.

powers.action_summary: Amend or supplement the list of required trainings by rule when new hazardous environmental remediation trainings become available.
powers.quote: Should new trainings in hazardous environmental remediation become available, the department after consultation with the department of health and mental hygiene, may by rule amend or supplement such list.
powers.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the creation of a voluntary master environmental hazard remediation technician registration program.

powers.action_summary: Audit training programs provided by approved training providers to ensure compliance with department standards.
powers.quote: The commissioner may audit training programs provided by approved training providers to ensure that such training programs meet the standards of the department.
powers.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the creation of a voluntary master environmental hazard remediation technician registration program.

powers.agency_full: New York City Department of Transportation
powers.action_summary: May close an open street to all motor vehicle traffic, except for emergency access, where such closure would benefit the community.
powers.quote: The department may, in accordance with its rules, provide for the closure of an open street to all motor vehicle traffic except as required for emergency access, where the department determines that such closure would benefit the community.
powers.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the open streets program.
